learned_selector_phase9_fingerprint_coll.must_not: be used for candidate selection, for any acceptance gate, or as grounds for evaluation-time rejection sampling of learned draws
learned_selector_phase9_fingerprint_coll.rationale: rejecting a learned draw at evaluation time would distort the very mixed distribution the diversity contract is stated over; measuring it keeps the residual visible instead of unmeasured
learned_selector_phase9_fingerprint_coll.requirement: enumerate, per candidate, arm, matchup and bank, both the count and the rate of produced final setups whose fingerprint lies in the accepted Phase 9 held-out fingerprint set

boundary_evidence.threshold: every link of the selection chain reproduces
exact Phase 9 identity and zero C1 optimizer steps

deviations.reading: the contract names a validation-case root but no separate test-case root, so 2026081806 roots the case schedule of both banks, domain-separated by their two distinct bank versions
deviations.why_safe: no root is added, no stream is reused, and the exhaustive collision audit proves every validation and test stream disjoint

deviations.contract_text: x(s) is the frozen 35-field trait vector
deviations.reading: the 35 frozen fields include four per-rank histograms, so the feature vector is their lossless flattening: 47 float64 scalars, nothing dropped and nothing invented
deviations.why_safe: the alternative would require discarding schema information by hand; the 16 exact linear relations this surfaces leave rank 31, and the frozen L2 penalty of 1e-3 makes the minimizer unique

deviations.contract_text: full-batch BCE + L2 1e-3 on family/trait parameters
deviations.reading: BCE is the mean over the 16,384 scheduled games and the penalty is lambda times the sum of squares of the raw family offsets and trait weights; the intercept is unpenalized
deviations.why_safe: a summed BCE would make 1e-3 effectively no regularization at 16,384 games; the mean is the reading under which the stated coefficient does the job the contract gives it

deviations.contract_text: 100,000 draws per candidate x color x split ... resume must be exact set subtraction by draw id
deviations.reading: Agent 4's audit needs a selector seed per addressable draw id and the first freeze produced none — case_selector_seed covers only the 1,280 bank-case seeds — so a tenth derived domain, selector_audit, was added under the existing selector_draw_seed root 2026081805
deviations.why_safe: no root seed was added or changed and no threshold, candidate, bank, schedule or utility definition moved; it removes an unfrozen choice Agent 4 would otherwise have had to invent, and it moves exactly two contract digests (phase10_setup_contract_v1, phase10_setup_selector_v1) plus the bundle, leaving both bank digests, both bank manifests, the schedule digest, the scaler digest and the isolation-set digest byte-identical

deviations.contract_text: zero exact final-setup fingerprint overlap with Phase 9 validation/test cases
deviations.reading: hard, rejection-enforced over every arrangement a Phase 10 case fixes — the opponent setup and both neutral_v1 own-side draws; a learned selector's own-side draw cannot exist before the selector does, so Agents 5-7 record its Phase 9 landings as a report-only diagnostic
deviations.why_safe: rejecting a learned draw at evaluation time would distort the very mixed distribution the diversity contract is stated over, and the diagnostic keeps the residual visible rather than unmeasured

handoff_to_agent_2.crash_resume_identity: a missing game is regenerated from its game id alone through rebuild_game + resolve_side; no derivation reads worker count, arrival order, process id, wall clock or a storage path
handoff_to_agent_2.mission: collect phase10_setup_outcome_corpus_v1; make no learning-design decision

outcome_record_schema.forbidden_fields: no opponent-private information, no model score, no strength signal, and no physical storage path may appear in a record
outcome_record_schema.replay_claim: game_id rebuilds both side draw seeds; each side's provenance rebuilds its exact final setup through the frozen sampler; the move-policy identity and checkpoint digests name the weights that moved; so any single record replays independently of every other record

handoff_to_agent_2.phase9_byte_preservation: Phase 9 checkpoint before Phase 10 == Phase 9 checkpoint after Phase 10, in both file SHA-256 and model-state digest, with zero C1 optimizer steps

sealing.access_log_rule: every test-bank access is recorded with its purpose
forbidden_before_agent_7: playing any game on a case
computing any model metric on a case
hyperparameter or threshold selection using a case

setup_derivations.rule: first attempt whose sample_setup('train', seed, profile='neutral_v1') primary family equals the scheduled family

storage_policy.absent_external_volume_rule: a configured root naming an unmounted /Volumes/... volume is BLOCKED; never silently create an internal replacement path
storage_policy.hard_coded_volume_paths_forbidden: no logical scheduling, model or selector identity may contain a /Volumes/... path; the resolved root appears only in manifests as a diagnostic
storage_policy.identity_rule: the resolved corpus root is an operational diagnostic, never an identity: Phase 10 corpus identity is corpus version + logical game ids + payload/metadata digests + commit identities, so the same bytes copied to another volume are the same corpus
storage_policy.preferred_location: the verified external volume for substantial corpus/replay bytes, recorded through the pointer file

handoff_to_agent_2.train_only_rule: every corpus setup comes from the Phase 7 train split; a validation or test base anywhere in the corpus is a BLOCKED leak

phase9_isolation_reconciliation.why_the_counts_differ: a Phase 9 pair stores each side oriented for the player that plays it, so one canonical arrangement appearing on a Red side in one case and a Blue side in another is two stored board strings and one canonical identity
